title: Conformalized Quantile Regression
abstract: We develop a general framework for distribution-free predictive inference, with the goal of producing predictive intervals that have finite-sample marginal coverage guarantees. Our approach is based on combining conformal prediction with quantile regression, allowing us to construct prediction intervals that adapt to heteroscedasticity in the data. The resulting algorithm, conformalized quantile regression (CQR), enjoys both the finite-sample coverage guarantee of conformal prediction and the statistical efficiency of quantile regression. We compare CQR to other baseline predictive intervals on both simulated and real data sets.
